name: What should I do immediately after my toilet overflows?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after my toilet overflows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately turn off the water supply to the toilet, usually via a small valve on the wall behind or near the base. Then, unplug any electrical devices in the affected area and begin removing standing water using towels or a wet vacuum. If the overflow is significant or involves contaminated water, contact a professional restoration service quickly to prevent further damage and mold growth. Avoid using ceiling fans if the overflow is on an upper floor, as this could spread contaminants.
acceptedAnswer.description: First, turn off the water supply to the toilet and unplug electrical devices. Then, remove standing water and contact a restoration service for significant overflows.
